rows.grounds: locative plural of sahasra, expressing location within thousands
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device), locative plural
past passive participle from root pīḍ (to press, afflict)

items.question: What is the extent and locus of torment experienced by beings in cyclic existence?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
The loci are described as womb-mechanisms.
Beings in these loci are characterized as tormented.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment across a vast multitude of womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
